Products¶

Derived products: moment maps, PV and moment FITS files, isosurfaces, and the 2-D image products (pixel arithmetic, mosaics, figures, quality metrics). The written files land in the Workspace Exports directory (see Exports).

Moments, PV and isosurfaces¶

POST /v1/products/moment¶

Synchronous moment map computation (small datasets / fast moments).

{
  "dataset_id": "...", "moment_order": 1,
  "channel_start": 10, "channel_end": 50,
  "mask_enabled": true, "threshold_value": 0.0, "threshold_auto": true
}

  • mask_enabled (default false at the API; the desktop client defaults it to true) — only voxels above the threshold contribute.

  • threshold_auto (default false) — when set with mask_enabled, the backend derives the threshold from the data as median + 3·σ (σ from the MAD), ignoring threshold_value. The estimate is strided in all three axes so it stays out-of-core on large cubes.

  • threshold_value — the manual threshold, used only when mask_enabled and not threshold_auto.

  • moment2_variance (default false) — for order 2, return the variance σ² instead of the dispersion σ. Ignored for other orders.

Response: valid, width, height, scalar_type, range_min, range_max, spectral_axis_type, spectral_axis_unit, moment_unit, bunit, threshold_used (the resolved threshold, null when no mask was applied), wcs_status, wcs_warning_message, base64 data.

Physical-range guard (M1/M2). Regardless of masking, the backend blanks M1 pixels outside the sampled spectral axis [vmin, vmax] and M2 pixels outside [0, span²]. These can only arise from mixed-sign (noise) weights and would otherwise produce non-physical (e.g. super-luminal) values; the guard never removes a legitimate positive-weight voxel.

Supported order values and their definitions:

Order

Name

Formula

Unit

0

Integrated intensity

Σ(I·dv)

BUNIT·spectral

1

Intensity-weighted coordinate

Σ(I·v·dv)/M0

spectral

2

Velocity dispersion σ (default) or intensity-weighted variance

√(Σ(I·(v−M1)²·dv)/M0), or without the root when moment2_variance is true

spectral (σ), spectral² (variance)

3

Skewness

μ₃/σ³

dimensionless

4

Excess kurtosis

μ₄/σ⁴ − 3

dimensionless

5

Standardised 5th moment

μ₅/σ⁵

dimensionless

6

RMS

√(Σ(I²·dv)/Σ(dv))

BUNIT

8

Maximum value

max(I)

BUNIT

10

Minimum value

min(I)

BUNIT

For orders 3–5, spectral_delta (channel spacing) is used as the integration weight. NaN/blanked voxels are excluded. Variance must be positive; pixels where σ=0 or M0=0 are set to NaN.

POST /v1/products/pv_fits¶

Compute the PV diagram along a path and save it as a 2-D FITS file in the Workspace Exports.

{ "dataset_id": "...", "vertices": [[12.5, 40.0], [130.0, 90.0]], "width_pixels": 3,
  "output_basename": "ngc3137_pv.fits" }

Axis 1 is OFFSET (arcsec, 0 at the first vertex, CDELT1 = step); axis 2 is the cube’s own spectral axis WCS (CTYPE/CUNIT/CRPIX/CRVAL, CDELT×PC or CD, PVn_m/PSn_m). BUNIT, beam, RESTFRQ/RESTWAV, SPECSYS are copied; PVWIDTH, PVSTEP and the vertices (HISTORY, pixel and sky) are recorded. An existing file is never overwritten (the name is suffixed). Response: valid, error, output_path, workspace_filename, width (samples), height (channels), range_min, range_max, bunit.

POST /v1/products/isosurface¶

{ "dataset_id": "...", "threshold": 0.05 }

Returns base64-encoded mesh data + bounds.

POST /v1/products/moment_fits¶

Compute a moment and save it as a 2-D FITS file in the Workspace Exports. The request is the /v1/products/moment request plus output_basename:

{ "dataset_id": "...", "moment_order": 0, "channel_start": 10, "channel_end": 50,
  "mask_enabled": true, "threshold_value": 0.0, "threshold_auto": true,
  "moment2_variance": false, "output_basename": "" }

An empty output_basename becomes <source stem>_m<order>.fits; an existing name gets a numeric suffix. The file carries the celestial WCS and a BUNIT derived from the cube. Response: valid, error, output_path, workspace_filename, width, height, range_min, range_max, bunit, moment_unit. A non-cube dataset is 422; a compute failure is valid: false. Runs in the heavy tier (see Worker pool).

Advanced 2-D products¶

Four routes over 2-D images (the first plane of a cube when a cube is given; degenerate axes are squeezed). Failures come back as valid: false with the reason; an unknown dataset is 404.

POST /v1/products/map_math¶

Pixel-wise arithmetic on one or two maps, written to a FITS file in the Workspace.

{ "dataset_id": "ds_a", "op": "spectral_index", "dataset_id_b": "ds_b",
  "freq_a": 1.4e9, "freq_b": 3.0e9, "output_basename": "" }

op

Needs

Result

log10, abs, square

map A

applied to A

add, subtract, multiply

A and B

A + B, A − B, A × B

divide, ratio

A and B

A / B

spectral_index

A, B, freq_a, freq_b (Hz, positive)

α = log10(A/B) / log10(ν_a/ν_b)

Map B is reprojected onto A’s grid (reproject_interp) when the shapes differ. The output keeps A’s header; BUNIT is cleared for divide, ratio and spectral_index, and a HISTORY card names the operation. The default file name is <A stem>_<op>.fits. Response (ProductFitsResponse): valid, error, output_path, workspace_filename, width, height, range_min, range_max, info ({op}).

POST /v1/products/mosaic¶

Reproject two or more images onto a common optimal celestial WCS and co-add them.

{ "dataset_ids": ["ds_1", "ds_2", "ds_3"], "weight_mode": "noise",
  "output_basename": "mosaic.fits" }

weight_mode: "noise" (default) weights each input by 1/σ², σ being its MAD-based robust standard deviation; "uniform" weights them equally. Fewer than two datasets is 422. The response has the same shape as map_math, with info = {n_inputs, weight_mode, coverage_fraction} (fraction of output pixels covered by at least one input).

POST /v1/products/publication_figure¶

Render an image as a figure file with a WCS sky grid and a colour bar labelled with BUNIT.

{ "dataset_id": "...", "cmap": "inferno", "stretch": "asinh", "percent": 99.5,
  "title": "", "add_grid": true, "add_colorbar": true, "dpi": 200,
  "output_basename": "field.pdf" }

stretch is linear, log, sqrt, asinh or power (astropy simple_norm, clipped at percent). The format follows the extension of output_basename (.png, .pdf, .svg; anything else gets .png appended); the default name is <stem>_figure.png. Without a celestial WCS the axes are in pixels. Response: valid, error, output_path, workspace_filename, width, height (image pixels), has_wcs.

POST /v1/products/image_quality¶

Quality and artefact metrics for an image. Request: {dataset_id}. Response: {valid, error, metrics} with

Metric

Meaning

total_pixels, blanked_fraction

Pixel count, fraction that is NaN or infinite

zero_fraction, negative_fraction

Among finite pixels

min, max, mean, median, robust_std

robust_std = 1.4826 × MAD

dynamic_range

max / robust_std

negative_bowl

min < −8 × robust_std

striping_metric

Ratio of the larger to the smaller variance of row means and column means

flags

Any of high_blanked_fraction (> 0.2), negative_bowl, striping (metric > 5), low_dynamic_range (< 5), all_blanked
